-* Frase tracks your prompts across AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI.
-* Frase shows prompt-level share-of-voice against the competitors you choose, with the actual answer text.
-* Frase runs daily monitoring with alerts plus a log of which AI crawlers reach your pages.

+- **Market Context (2026):** ~68% of Google searches end without a click (Jan–Apr 2026 data). ChatGPT reached ~900M weekly active users (Feb 2026); Google Gemini app passed 750M monthly active users; AI Overviews reach 2B+ people monthly.
+- **Core Function:** AI visibility tools track brand citations in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI) rather than traditional SERP rankings.
+- **Evaluation Criteria:**
+  - **Multi-engine coverage:** Track all major assistants to avoid blind spots.
+  - **Prompt-level tracking:** Identify specific prompts triggering citations or misses.
+  - **Competitive benchmarking:** Share-of-voice analysis against named competitors.
+  - **Sentiment/Context:** Verify accuracy of brand mentions.
+  - **Citation attribution:** Identify which specific pages earn citations.
+  - **Actionability:** Tool must connect insights to content optimization workflows (monitoring + fixing).
+- **Tool Rankings & Use Cases:**
+  1. **Frase:** Best for integrated monitor-and-fix workflows. Tracks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI. Connects tracking to research, writing, optimization, and publishing.
+  2. **Profound:** Best for enterprise depth and compliance. Broad multi-engine coverage with crawler-level data and global snapshots.
+  3. **Positive Surfer (formerly Surfer SEO):** Best for teams already using Surfer. Combines AI citation tracking with content optimization scores.
+  4. **Writesonic:** Best for early-mover brand mention and sentiment tracking with competitor benchmarking.
+  5. **AthenaHQ:** Best for growth-stage SaaS. Prompt tracking paired with an "action center" for GEO analytics.
+  6. **Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit:** Best for teams already in Semrush. Integrates AI data (including AI Overviews) into existing SEO suite.
+  7. **SE Ranking:** Best for SEO pros. Tracks AI Overviews, AI Mode, and chatbots within a core SEO workflow.
+  8. **ZipTie:** Best for technical GEO audits. Flags pages unreachable by AI crawlers (indexation issues).
+  9. **Peec AI:** Best for large-scale prompt tracking. Handles large prompt sets with citation source classification.
+  10. **Otterly.ai:** Best for entry-level/budget monitoring. Tiered plans for small teams starting out.
+- **Pricing Benchmarks (Self-Serve, Sept 2026):**
+  - **Semrush:** From $165.17/mo (billed annually).
+  - **SE Ranking:** From $103.20/mo (billed annually) + AI Search add-on.
+  - **Positive Surfer:** From $49/mo (billed yearly) + AI visibility tier.
+  - **ZipTie:** Usage-based, from $35.63/mo.
+  - **Frase/Profound/Peec/AthenaHQ/Writesonic/Otterly:** Pricing varies by scope/enterprise tier; confirm current rates on vendor sites.
+- **Key Differentiator:** The primary value driver is whether the tool stops at alerting or provides a workflow to fix the citation gap (research → draft → optimize → publish).
